## How did you check it? / 怎么验证的？



## Checklist / 自查

- [ ] No game assets, game code, keys, player data or modified packages, and no links to them. / 不含游戏资源、游戏代码、密钥、玩家数据、改版安装包，也不含它们的链接。
- [ ] Nothing about distributing, selling or sharing modified builds, cheats or private servers. / 不涉及传播、出售、分享改版安装包，或者外挂、私服。
- [ ] Only about games whose official service has permanently ended. / 只涉及官方服务已永久结束的游戏。
- [ ] New pitfall entries use Symptom → Cause → Fix and say how the cause was confirmed. / 新踩坑条目按「现象 → 原因 → 修法」写，并说明原因是怎么确认的。
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Cynthia-wlan9509/offline-game-revival/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and release this contribution under the MIT License. / 我已读过 CONTRIBUTING.md，同意贡献内容按 MIT 许可证发布。
